correctness.rationale: Relative order patterns on disjoint position sets are independent under independent continuous ranks, so only overlaps at lags 0,1,2 contribute. Enumerating all 24 patterns of length four and all 120 of length five defines exact Q1,Q2; their weighted covariance matrix is M_n/360. An independently written symbolic SymPy check reconstructed the Q matrices and FACTORED the full characteristic polynomial identically for symbolic n; the fixed eigenmode v=(0,-1,1,-1,1,0) has eigenvalue 1/8. The peak-minus-valley indicator at each interior position telescopes to A_(n-1)-A_1, two independent fair Bernoullis for n>=4. This mode has variance 1/2, norm squared four. The other four eigenvalues are strictly >1/8 by the displayed radical comparison and have positive linear growth; the radical-plus root is largest. For n=4 two linear eigenvalues tie; the only zero is all-ones. All-size statement follows from fixed overlap enumeration and polynomial algebra, not numerical n<=300 examples.
